items.headline: 5-unit condo building permitted on Florence Avenue
items.summary: A permit was issued for a new 5-plex condo development at 2820 Florence Avenue, valued at roughly $1.38 million.

items.headline: Nine ADU permits listed in San José’s weekly feed
items.summary: The notable-permit feed lists nine accessory dwelling unit permits issued between Sept. 23–28, several involving garage conversions, with reported values from about $54,500 to $185,800. This is a count of the listed permits, not a citywide total.

items.headline: Council weighs potential legal case against fire truck makers
items.summary: The City Council met in closed session to discuss a potential case involving Golden State Fire Apparatus, Pierce Manufacturing, Oshkosh, REV Group, Rosenbauer America, and the Fire Apparatus Manufacturers' Association. No outcome was announced.

items.headline: Council discussed appointing a new City Attorney
items.summary: The closed session agenda included a public employee appointment item for the position of City Attorney.

items.headline: Council approves subdivision map for 408-unit El Camino Real housing
items.summary: Santa Clara City Council approved a vesting tentative subdivision map for 408 residential units at 451 El Camino Real on Sept. 22. The portion covering the San José parcel takes effect only after Santa Clara LAFCO finalizes its detachment and annexation.

items.headline: City in talks with school district over Cubberley site
items.summary: The Palo Alto City Council’s Sept. 22 agenda listed a closed-session conference on negotiating purchase, exchange, or lease terms for the Cubberley Community Center site at 4000 Middlefield Road with the Palo Alto Unified School District.
